sens_en: to run, to rush, to head for
origine_fr: Un homme qui court, bras ballants, au-dessus de trois pieds 止 qui disent la vitesse. L'homme est devenu 大, et les trois pieds 十 et 卄. Le sens n'a pas bougé : courir, se précipiter.
origine_en: A man running with swinging arms, above three feet 止 that show speed. The man has become 大, and the three feet 十 and 卄. The meaning has not moved: to run, to rush.

phrase.fr: Les enfants courent sur la pelouse.
phrase.en: The children are running about on the grass.
